coupling.sharedSurface: HTTP API contract — endpoint paths, request/response field names and types, and status/error codes the web app consumes.
coupling.notes: Dual only when the wire shape changes. A pure backend refactor that keeps every response identical is api-only.

notes: This is a sample. For a single-repo project, drop a .worktree.json at the repo root instead of adding a registry file. For multi-repo projects, put your real config in $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/projects/<name>.json (persists across plugin updates) or set WORKTREE_REGISTRY_DIR.
caveats: Env files are copied point-in-time, not symlinked — re-copy after edits, or use --no-env.
A worktree dev server may collide on the same PORT as the main checkout — change it or stop the other.
